name: Eluna Media: Video Converter
subtitle: Audio, photo & GIF compressor
promotionalText: Convert and compress on the phone itself. No account, no ads, no subscriptions. The app makes no network requests of its own.
description:
Convert and compress video, audio and photos on the phone itself. No account, no ads, no subscriptions, and the app makes no network requests of its own — your files never leave the device.

HIT AN EXACT SIZE
Choose 10, 16, 25, 50, 100 MB or your own number. The bitrate is worked out from the real duration with a safety margin, so the result lands under the limit instead of near it.

COMPRESSION THAT CANNOT BACKFIRE
An already-compressed file will not come out bigger than it went in.

FORMATS
Video: MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM, AVI with H.264, H.265, AV1, VP9 — or remux with no re-encoding at all.
Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, Opus, plus the sound pulled out of any video.
Photos: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF, animated GIF and animated WebP. Camera-roll HEIC is read properly.

EDITING
Trim, rotate, mirror, crop to 1:1, 9:16, 16:9 or 4:3, speed 0.25x to 4x, volume, resize, merge clips, sharpen or denoise a photo.

BATCH
Hundreds of files in one queue. One broken file never kills the batch, every job shows progress and time remaining, and the queue survives a restart.

PRIVACY
EXIF, GPS and timestamps are stripped from every result by default. Lock the app with a passcode or Face ID.

FREE
Every feature from the start, batch included. There is no paid tier and no watermark. The only thing that can be bought is a tip, and it unlocks nothing.

ONE HONEST NOTE
iOS suspends apps that are not on screen, so a conversion pauses when you leave Eluna Media. Keep it open while a long job runs.

Free and open source: github.com/vacoolstudio-rgb/eluna-media
